related.description: :nut_and_bolt: An oh-my-zsh plugin for git clone && cd
A clean, distraction free and git focused development theme for Oh-my-zsh
A zsh plugin to manage the Oh My Posh prompt theme engine, along with providing a default powerline like theme.
Colorful multiline oh-my-zsh theme. Includes git, nvm and error code status decorations.
